Distance, displacement, speed and veloci: Distance is a scalar path length; displacement is a vector. Average speed is total distance over total time.
Uniform and non-uniform motion: In uniform motion equal distances are covered in equal times. The slope of a distance–time graph is the speed.
Acceleration: Acceleration is velocity change per time. The slope of a v–t graph is acceleration and its area is distance.
Equations of motion: The three equations of motion link u, v, a, t and s. Free fall has a = g ≈ 9.8 m/s².
